restrictions: Fixed-IV SHA-256, first 44 steps, standard padding and feed-forward, equality of all 256 output bits; one 64-byte data block per message from the standard IV, followed by the common SHA-256 padding block (equal inputs give the equal padding block, so a first-data-block collision is a full-message collision). The data block is words 0..15 of the shifted pair (schedule words -4..11 of the generator pair): 16 arbitrary 32-bit words, run through the unmodified SHA-256 schedule recurrence and constants K_i at their original indices i.

Prices: one 44-step target compression is one unit; every other primitive word operation is 1/C with C = 3232 (the organizer reference counting method run at 44 rounds; it gives 2896 at 40). Verifying a found pair is 4 reduced compressions (the data block and the padding block of each of the two messages), charged as one unit each (4 units per found pair), separately from the word operations.

Head (proof Section 2): the shipped program (VOL40 v7e generator, W13 retries 22, pairs shifted back four schedule words; bit-sliced, 256 lanes; one gate on 256 lanes = one word op, as R40 entry df1f1cd1). Per kept pair 12,499.8 charged ops = (3,121.821 word ops per kept pair = (183,000 generation budget + 256 x 300 per lane + 237,500 control block + 164,526 support work) / 212) x 4 loads/stores = 12,487.3, x 1/(1 - 0.001) for discards; 2^1.95140 units. Generation = declared budget 183,000 word ops per batch (hard bound; measured 127,471-128,729 over 20,000 trials) / kept floor 212. Inside ops_used: 300 per lane (199 itemized: leading-bit count on the batch-transposed junction difference) and 237,500 per batch (237,346 itemized: 16 control lanes recomputed at word level, 32 tally lanes, best-lane output). A batch halting at the budget or keeping < 212 lanes is discarded and still charged; discard fraction <= 0.001 (H-kept-pair-yield).

Landing and tail (proof Section 3): the J30 difference of a shifted pair lands on the target with probability 2^-256 per pair (premise P1, a declared heuristic: the exact full-width rate is the premise, measured jointly to 16 bits on shifted pairs and to 32 bits on the unshifted generator pairs); from the target the pair collides after step 44 with probability 1 (premise P2, by construction: the shifted schedule difference is silent on words 31..43 for every generated pair (proof Section 3 derivation) and the target cancels the step-30 word difference, so the two computations coincide from the junction on; forced-target implementation check 320,000/320,000 (shipped program, first 16 kept lanes, 20,000 trials) and 48,459/48,459 (evidence program, every kept lane), negative control 0/48,459).

Ledger: N = (ln(1/0.61) + 2^-990) x 2^256 pairs; T = B x (183,000 + 256 x 300 + 237,500 + 164,526) x 4 / 3232 + 4 + 2^28.2 with the FIXED batch count B = ceil(N / (212 x (1 - 0.001))): a deterministic total-work bound (every batch charged at the generation budget plus the per-lane block for all 256 lanes, kept or not, discarded or not, plus the per-batch control block CTRL = 237,500 plus the itemized support work SUPPORT = 164,526); per kept pair this is 12,499.8 charged operations = 2^1.95140 units; the run stops at the first found pair (4 reduced compressions); success 0.39 is unconditional: the 2^-990 margin in N exceeds the Chernoff tail (below 2^-1000) of more than a 0.001 fraction of discarded batches at the declared p <= 2.5e-4 (alpha 0.01, as the organizer specifies; measured 0 of 20,000); log2 T = 256.93486 (exact 256.93485200, rounded up to five decimals); hard bound: the program halts before a retry if its max cost 1,585 + the max post-loop work 144,249 would pass the budget.

Memory (complete under the model; every live container of trial() at its peak): list subsets 357,408 (conservative bound) + program code 64,678 + 256-lane sliced state 345,216 (337 sliced words of 1,024 bytes: S.prev 148, CK 48, m1+m2s 36, W+Vc 48, X/Y/XS/YS/DS 40, other 17; 4 masks of 32) + word-level state 17,296 (4,324 words: DU 2,048, da/de/SLA/k13/bitmatch 1,280, S.prev keys 160, run() locals 39, other 797) + current messages 128 + driver state 44,060 (request <= 256 trials 40,960 + current result <= 3,100; results streamed) + random.Random state 2,500 (624 words + index; JSON workspace = the driver state) + streaming scalars 12 = 831,298 bytes (2^19.67 rounded up; term 0), in 4-byte words of the model's word RAM. Preprocessing: 7 list passes over 2^32 candidates at <= 29 word ops (loop 3, condition 24, append 2) = 7 x 2^25.20 = 2^28.01 compressions + 422 for the subsets (total 2^28.01); declared 2^28.2 (proof Section 5); per-pair random draws are charged as word ops.

Premises P1, P2, P3 (independence across pairs) and H-kept-pair-yield are declared heuristics of the exploratory lane (proof Section 6); P1 and P3 are stated for the shipped program as executed, its seeded draws included.

heuristics.statement: For shifted pairs output by the shipped program as executed (its seeded random.Random draws included), over the organizer's seed space, the 256-bit J30 XOR difference equals the J30 target with probability 2^-256 per pair.
heuristics.scope: the shipped program's shifted pairs, standard IV, 44 steps. Tested regime: organizer seeds, 256 lanes per trial; joint landing to 16 bits on shifted pairs and to 32 bits on the unshifted generator; organizer-verified mask events at 6 and 8 bits. Extrapolated regime: the exact 256-bit event over ~2^255 pairs. Score sensitivity: a per-bit landing rate 2^-(1+e) instead of 2^-1 changes log2 T by 256e.
heuristics.extrapolation: Shifted pairs of this generator and shift: 36 organizer-format trials (8,749 pairs) k=8 landing 44 (expected 34.2); 200 trials (48,459 pairs) k=8 landing 220 (expected 189.3), k=16 landing 1 (expected 0.74). Pooled over the 21 shifted packages R41-R61 (same generator, 183,497 pairs): k=8 landing 745 (expected 716.8), k=16 landing 4 (expected 2.80); a further 4,704 trials of the same 21 experiments on a second machine (1,138,197 pairs): k=8 landing 4,518 (expected 4,446.1), k=16 landing 14 (expected 17.37); all 1,321,694 pairs together: k=8 landing 5,263 (expected 5,162.9), k=16 landing 18 (expected 20.17). The unshifted VOL40 generator pairs land at 2^-8.00/2^-16.00/2^-23.98/2^-31.83 for k=8/16/24/32 on 2^36 states; per-bit |p-0.5| <= 0.00001; extended to 256 bits under independence of bits. The shipped program over 20,000 organizer-format fresh-seed trials: landing k8 18,940 (expected 18,941.9), k16 86 (74.0), k24 0 (0.29), k32 0 (0.001); failed trials 0. Organizer-verified mask events (experiments v44-mask-k8 and v44-mask-k6, the same generator; each trial returns the pair with the most masked digest-XOR zeros among its first 32 kept lanes): the organizer's own run on its fixed public seeds recorded 33 hits vs 30.1 expected (k=8) and 100 vs 101.3 (k=6) over 256 trials each (trusted execution report of 1cfe02f6); our run on seeds 1..256, a second sample: 36 and 101. Organizer-run evidence: every trial of experiment v44-shift-01 reports landing_k8, landing_k16, landing_k24, landing_k32 and best_lead_bits for its kept pairs; the expected counts are kept x 2^-k, and the per-trial landing_k8 counts give the dispersion test for P3.
heuristics.limitations: Joint landing on shifted pairs is measured to 16 bits (counts above); the 32-bit joint evidence is from the unshifted generator; the step to all 256 bits is premise P1. Landing-rate check on the pooled shifted k=8 count: 5,263 vs 5,162.9 expected, z = +1.39 (one-sided p 0.08); the unshifted program on 4,331,098 pairs gives z = -0.27. Seeds were fixed before any run and every run is reported.

heuristics.statement: A shifted pair from the shipped program whose J30 difference equals the target collides after step 44 with probability 1.
heuristics.scope: the shipped program's shifted pairs at the J30 target, standard IV, 44 steps. Tested regime: the forced-target implementation check on real program states (320,000 shipped-program lanes, 48,459 evidence-program pairs, 8,749 pairs) and the derivation of proof Section 3 for every generated lane. Extrapolated regime: every landing pair of the run.
heuristics.extrapolation: By construction: the shifted schedule difference is silent on words 31..43 for every generated lane (proof Section 3: each silent word is forced by a list membership checked over every embedded list word, by the W13 retry test on every kept lane, or is a constant; no word rests on a sampled check) and the J30 target cancels the step-30 word difference, so from the junction on the two computations coincide and the pair collides. Implementation check with the target forced on real program states: 48,459/48,459 (evidence program, every kept lane, 200 trials) and 8,749/8,749 (36 trials); negative control (bit 30 of register h) 0 in both; the shipped program asserts this on the first 16 kept lanes of every trial (20,000 fresh-seed trials, 0 failures).
heuristics.limitations: The implementation check uses forced-target states; the probability-1 claim rests on the structural argument.

heuristics.statement: Landing events of distinct pairs output by the shipped program as executed (its seeded draws included) are independent.
heuristics.scope: pairs within and across batches of the shipped program, standard IV, 44 steps. Tested regime: per-trial k=8 dispersion over 4,200 and 200 trials, kept-lane variance over 20,000 batches. Extrapolated regime: independence of the exact 256-bit event over ~2^255 pairs.
heuristics.extrapolation: Pairs of one batch share the generator words except the retried word, so they are not independent by construction; after the shift no compression step is shared (the first shifted word depends on the retried word), and each organizer trial is one batch of 256 lanes, so the per-trial dispersion tests exactly the within-batch dependence; the VOL40 batch test (64 batches x 512 pairs, dispersion chi-square 65.0 vs 64 +- 11.3) covers the shared generator part. Shifted pairs, the 4,200 second-machine trials whose per-trial outputs were retained (1,016,296 pairs; the other 504 second-machine trials kept only totals, k=8 508 vs 476.2 expected): per-trial k=8 dispersion chi-square 4,197.8 vs 4,199 +- 91.6; this program's 200 trials alone (48,459 pairs): 214.2 vs 199 +- 19.9. The shipped program over 20,000 trials: kept variance 12.88 vs binomial 12.83, ratio 1.004. Organizer-run evidence: the per-trial landing_k8 counts in the trusted report (each trial = one batch of 256 lanes) are the dispersion sample; under P3 their variance equals their mean.
heuristics.limitations: Tested on the landing indicators the program reports; independence of the exact 256-bit event over the full run is the declared premise. Seeds were fixed before any run and every run is reported.

heuristics.statement: Each batch of 256 lanes keeps each lane with probability 0.946 (measured); a batch is discarded, and still charged, if it keeps fewer than 212 lanes or halts at the declared generation budget of 183,000 word operations; the fraction of discarded batches over the run is at most 0.001 (declared). Lane-keeping indicators within a batch are modelled as independent Bernoulli(0.946) (declared; measured kept-per-batch variance 11.90 vs binomial 12.97 over 200 batches, ratio 0.917; 12.88 vs 12.83, ratio 1.004 over 20,000 batches).
heuristics.scope: the shipped program, standard IV, 44 steps, every batch of the run
heuristics.extrapolation: Measured over 200 organizer-format fresh-seed batches of the evidence program: kept per batch mean 242.3, minimum 232, maximum 250; generation 127,471-128,729 word operations per batch over the 20,000 batches of the shipped program; discarded batches 0 of 200 and 0 of 20,000; none under the floor. The shipped program over 20,000 further fresh-seed batches: kept minimum 227, mean 242.5; generation 127,471-128,729; discarded or failed trials 0. With B about 2^247.3 batches and a declared per-batch discard probability p <= 2.5e-4 (premise H-kept-pair-yield; the shipped program's 0 discards in 20,000 batches give the one-sided bound 2.31e-4 at alpha 0.01, the organizer's alpha, below the declared value; every hard-check failure of a batch is a discard and is in the measured count), the probability that more than 0.001 B batches are discarded is below exp(-B x D(0.001 || 2.5e-4)) < 2^-1000 (D = 0.00063 nats per batch), so the fixed batch count B suffices with the stated success probability. The organizer report lists kept, ops_used, checks_failed and checks_mask for every trial.
heuristics.limitations: The per-lane rate, the independence model and the discard probability bound p <= 2.5e-4 (alpha 0.01) are declared; the budget and the floor are enforced by the program (a violating batch fails its trial); the Chernoff bound assumes independent batches (fresh organizer seeds per trial). Seeds were fixed before any run and every run is reported.
